label: Rerank
description: Reorder documents by relevance to a query through the wired OpenRouter connection: pick the rerank model on the provider node (cohere/rerank-4-pro, ...). Emits the documents best-first plus each one's score.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.description: Wire an OpenRouterProvider whose model names a rerank model.

inputs.name: topN
inputs.label: Top N
inputs.description: Only return the best N. Empty = all, reordered.

outputs.name: scores
outputs.description: Each entry: the original index and its relevance score, best first.
